tool_defs.name: get_telemetry
tool_defs.description: Return current aircraft, mission, weather, alerts, and active failsafe telemetry.

tool_defs.name: get_weather
tool_defs.description: Return current wind and coarse gust-front forecast at a location.

tool_defs.name: get_airspace
tool_defs.description: Return static airspace zones and optional route conflicts.

tool_defs.name: get_mission_status
tool_defs.description: Return mission status and target/SLA details.

tool_defs.name: get_sites
tool_defs.description: Return launch/recovery site information.

tool_defs.name: file_flight_plan
tool_defs.description: File a waypoint route for the autopilot to fly analytically.

tool_defs.name: amend_route
tool_defs.description: Replace the remaining route from the current aircraft position.

tool_defs.name: set_altitude
tool_defs.description: Set commanded altitude for subsequent route execution.

tool_defs.name: set_speed
tool_defs.description: Set commanded airspeed for subsequent route execution.

tool_defs.name: hold
tool_defs.description: Hold position for a number of simulated minutes.

tool_defs.name: resume
tool_defs.description: Resume after a hold or acknowledged alert.

tool_defs.name: command_rtl
tool_defs.description: Command autonomous return to a recovery site and land.

site_id.description: Optional site id. Defaults to the nearest recovery site.

tool_defs.name: land_now
tool_defs.description: Land immediately at current position or route to a named recovery site and land.

tool_defs.name: release_payload
tool_defs.description: Release payload at the delivery/inspection target if within tolerance.

tool_defs.name: abort_mission
tool_defs.description: Abort the active mission and mark it failed.

tool_defs.name: override_failsafe
tool_defs.description: Override an active overridable failsafe using an enum justification code.

tool_defs.name: acknowledge
tool_defs.description: Acknowledge an alert by alert_id.

tool_defs.description: Set commanded altitude for subsequent route execution.

tool_defs.name: set_speed
tool_defs.description: Set commanded airspeed for subsequent route execution.

tool_defs.name: hold
tool_defs.description: Hold position for a number of simulated minutes.

tool_defs.name: resume
tool_defs.description: Resume after a hold or acknowledged alert.

tool_defs.name: command_rtl

site_id.description: Optional site id. Defaults to the nearest recovery site.

tool_defs.name: get_telemetry
tool_defs.description: Return current aircraft, mission, weather, alerts, and active failsafe telemetry.

tool_defs.name: get_weather
tool_defs.description: Return current wind and coarse gust-front forecast at a location.

tool_defs.name: get_airspace
tool_defs.description: Return static airspace zones and optional route conflicts.

tool_defs.name: get_mission_status
tool_defs.description: Return mission status and target/SLA details.

tool_defs.name: get_sites
tool_defs.description: Return launch/recovery site information.

tool_defs.name: file_flight_plan
tool_defs.description: File a waypoint route for the autopilot to fly analytically.

tool_defs.name: amend_route
tool_defs.description: Replace the remaining route from the current aircraft position.

tool_defs.name: set_altitude
tool_defs.description: Set commanded altitude for subsequent route execution.

tool_defs.name: set_speed
tool_defs.description: Set commanded airspeed for subsequent route execution.

tool_defs.name: hold
tool_defs.description: Hold position for a number of simulated minutes.

tool_defs.name: resume
tool_defs.description: Resume after a hold or acknowledged alert.

tool_defs.name: command_rtl
tool_defs.description: Command autonomous return to a recovery site and land.

site_id.description: Optional site id. Defaults to the nearest recovery site.

tool_defs.name: land_now
tool_defs.description: Land immediately at current position or route to a named recovery site and land.

tool_defs.name: release_payload
tool_defs.description: Release payload at the delivery/inspection target if within tolerance.

tool_defs.name: abort_mission
tool_defs.description: Abort the active mission and mark it failed.

tool_defs.name: override_failsafe
tool_defs.description: Override an active overridable failsafe using an enum justification code.

tool_defs.name: acknowledge
tool_defs.description: Acknowledge an alert by alert_id.
